mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT snapshot_no FROM sa_knowledge_snapshot WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{knowledgeBaseId} ORDER BY snapshot_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE),0)

SELECT d.id document_id,v.id document_version_id,v.version_no,d.title FROM sa_document d JOIN sa_document_version v ON v.id=d.current_published_version_id AND v.document_id=d.id AND v.knowledge_base_id=d.knowledge_base_id AND v.project_id=d.project_id WHERE d.knowledge_base_id=#{knowledgeBaseId} AND d.status='ACTIVE' AND v.process_status='READY' AND v.publish_status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY d.id FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_knowledge_snapshot WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{knowledgeBaseId}

SELECT s.*,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_knowledge_snapshot_item i WHERE i.snapshot_id=s.id) item_count FROM sa_knowledge_snapshot s WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{knowledgeBaseId} ORDER BY s.snapshot_no DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT s.*,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_knowledge_snapshot_item i WHERE i.snapshot_id=s.id) item_count FROM sa_knowledge_snapshot s WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT i.document_id,i.document_version_id,v.version_no,d.title FROM sa_knowledge_snapshot_item i JOIN sa_document_version v ON v.id=i.document_version_id JOIN sa_document d ON d.id=i.document_id WHERE i.snapshot_id=#{id} ORDER BY i.sort_order,i.id

SELECT i.document_version_id FROM sa_knowledge_snapshot_item i JOIN sa_knowledge_snapshot s ON s.id=i.snapshot_id WHERE i.snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.knowledge_base_id=#{knowledgeBaseId} ORDER BY i.sort_order,i.id
